elements.title: Elizabeth Schuyler Hamilton (Wikipedia — did you know?)

elements.title: African bush elephants (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that young male African bush elephants in musth killed about 49 white rhinoceros in Pilanesberg National Park between 1992 and 1997?

elements.title: Scholastique Dianzinga (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Scholastique Dianzinga edited a post-independence history of women in the Republic of the Congo that discussed why women's emancipation has been hindered?
